content.hebrew: יִשְׁתַּבַּח אֵל עֶלְיוֹן, קוֹנֵה שָׁמַֽיִם וְחֵילָם,
content.transliteration: Yishtabbaḥ El ‘elyon, ḳonē shamayim veḥelam,
content.english: Praised be El ‘Elyon, maker of the heavens and their host,
content.comments: El ‘Elyon. A name for God; traditional English: “the most high God.”

content.hebrew: וּמוֹצִיא בְמִסְפָּר צְבָאָם, וּבְשֵׁם יִקְרָא לְכֻלָּם.
content.transliteration: Umotsi vemispar tseva’am, uvshem yiḳra lekhullam.
content.english: The one who brings out their legions by number, and calls each by name.

content.hebrew: סוֹבֵל עֶלְיוֹנִים וְתַחְתּוֹנִים, פְּרָטָם וּכְלָלָם,
content.transliteration: Sovel ‘elyonim vetaḥtonim, peratam ukhlalam,
content.english: He bears the upper and lower [creations], the individual[s that] they [contain], and their totality.

content.hebrew: פּוֹתֵֽחַ אֶת־יָדוֹ, וּמַשְׂבִּֽיעַ לְכָל־חַי מִשְׁאָלָם.
content.transliteration: Pote’aḥ et yado, umasbi’a‘ lekhol ḥai mish’alam.
content.english: He opens His hand, and satisfies the request of every living thing.

content.hebrew: בְּחַסְדּוֹ בְּרָאָם וּבְרַחֲמָיו פְּעָלָם.
content.transliteration: Beḥasdo bera’am uvraḥamav pe‘alam.
content.english: In His kindness He created them, and in His mercy He made them.

content.hebrew: נֹתֵן אָכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ, לְמִקְטַנָּם וְעַד גְּדוֹלָם.
content.transliteration: Noten okhlam be‘itto, lemiḳtannam ve‘ad gedolam.
content.english: He gives their food in its time, from the smallest of them to the greatest.

content.hebrew: מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים הֶעֱלָה עַמּוֹ, וּמִמִּצְרַיִם גְּאָלָם.
content.transliteration: Mibbet ‘avadim he‘ela ‘ammo, umimmitsrayim ge’alam.
content.english: From the house of bondage He brought up His people; from Egypt, He redeemed them.

content.hebrew: רֹגַע הַיָּם בְּכֹחוֹ, וְעַל מֵי מְנוּחוֹת נִהֲלָם.
content.transliteration: Roḡa‘ hayyam bekhoḥo, ve‘al mē menuḥot nihalam.
content.english: He calmed down the Sea with His might, and led them through peaceful waters.

content.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָתוֹ הִשְׁמִיעָם, וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו הִנְחִילָם.
content.transliteration: Divrē torato hishmi‘am, umishpatav hinḥilam.
content.english: He informed them the words of His Torah, and granted them His laws as an inheritance.

content.hebrew: כִּלֵּל יָפְיָם בְּהוֹדוֹ, וּמִכָּל־עָם הִבְדִּילָם.
content.transliteration: Killel yofyam behodo, umikkol ‘am hivdilam.
content.english: He gave them complete beauty from His splendor, and He distinguished them from all nations.

content.hebrew: יָדַע לֶכְתָּם בַּמִּדְבָּר, עַד הֱבִיאָם אֶל גְּבוּלָם.
content.transliteration: Yada‘ lekhtam bammidbar, ‘ad hevi’am el gevulam.
content.english: He knew their wanderings in the wilderness, until He brought them to their border.

content.hebrew: וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַן בֵּיתוֹ אִשְּׁרָם, וְאִשֵּׁר מַסְלוּלָם.
content.transliteration: Vesham ne’eman beto ish’sheram, ve’ish’sher maslulam.
content.english: And there, the faithful one of His house made them secure, and made their path secure.
content.comments: The faithful one of His house. Moses.

content.hebrew: צִוָּה לְבַל יִזְנוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וּפִסְלָם,
content.transliteration: Tsivva leval yiznu aḥarē Elohim aḥerim ufislam,
content.english: He instructed them not to go a-whoring after other gods and their idols,

content.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר שֶֽׁקֶר נִחֲלוּם אֲבוֹתָם מֵעוֹלָם.
content.transliteration: Asher sheḳer niḥalum avotam me‘olam.
content.english: [Of the peoples] whose ancestors had left them a legacy of falsehood, from long ago.

content.hebrew: אַךְ כִּי בַּיוי יִבְטְחוּ, וְלוֹ יָשִׂימוּ כִסְלָם,
content.transliteration: Akh ki ba’Adonai yivteḥu, velo yasimu khislam,
content.english: But rather, they should trust in Adonai, and put their confidence in Him.

content.hebrew: כִּי הוּא עֻזָּם וּמָעֻזָּם, הוּא כֹּחָם וְחֵילָם.
content.transliteration: Ki hu ‘uzzam uma‘uzzam, hu koḥam veḥelam.
content.english: For He is their strength and their stronghold; He is their power and their might;

content.hebrew: הוּא חֶלְקָם וְגוֹרָלָם, הוּא נַחֲלָתָם וְחֶבְלָם.
content.transliteration: Hu ḥelḳam veḡoralam, hu naḥalatam veḥevlam.
content.english: He is their portion and their lot; He is their inheritance and their estate.

content.hebrew: לוֹ נָקָם וְשִׁלֵּם, לְעֵת תָּמוּט רַגְלָם,
content.transliteration: Lo naḳam veshillem, le‘et tamut raḡlam,
content.english: To Him [belong] vengeance and retribution, at the time when their leg falters.

content.hebrew: הוּא יוֹצִיאֵם מֵחֶשְׁכָּם, וְיָאִיר אֲפֵלָם.
content.transliteration: Hu yotsi’em meḥeshkam, veya’ir afelam,
content.english: He will bring them out of their darkness, and bring light to their pitch blackness.

content.hebrew: לָכֵן הֵם וּבְנֵיהֶם וּבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם בְּמַקְהֵלָם
content.transliteration: Lakhen hem uvnehem uvnē venehem bemaḳhelam
content.english: Therefore, they, and their children, and their children’s children, in their chorus,

content.hebrew: קהל: יְבָרְכוּ שְׁמוֹ וְיַקְדִּישֽׁוּהוּ בְּמַהֲלָלָם;
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Yevarekhu shemo veyaḳdishu bemahalalam;
content.english: Cong. Will render blessing to His name, and declare His sanctity in their praise;

content.hebrew: חזן: יְיַחֲדוּ אוֹתוֹ, וְיַעֲנוּ בְּרֹן קוֹלָם:
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Yeyaḥadu oto, veya‘anu beron ḳolam:
content.english: Cantor. They will declare His oneness, and answer, in the joyous song of their voice:

content.hebrew: קהל: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יו֥י אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יו֥י ׀ אֶחָֽד:
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Shema‘ Yisra’el Adonai elohenu Adonai, eḥad:
content.english: Cong. Hear O Israel, Adonai our God is Adonai on His own. (Deut. 6:4)
content.comments: Adonai on His own. The translation follows Sefer Ha-mivḥar, on Deuteronomy 6:4: “The meaning is that He is one and does not need any second one.”
